statement.p: Consider the integral \int \frac{x^{21}-3 x^{14}+6 x^7-16}{\left(x^3-6 x^2+5 x\right)^3 \left(x^4-625\right)^2} \,dx Enter a T or an F in each answer space below to indicate whether or not a term of the given type occurs in the general form of the complete partial fractions decomposition of the integrand. A_1, A_2, A_3\dots and B_1, B_2, B_3,\dots denote constants.
You must get all of the answers correct to receive credit.
